Field.name: FinalPatchTypeOrXYZ
Field.usage: Final, largest patch size to try (S, M, L, E or size in X, Y, and Z)
Field.manpage: Largest patch size to try. Enter a letter to indicate the size of patches, or three numbers for the desired size in X, Y, and Z. The sizes available by letter are S for small (64x32x64), M for medium (80x40x80), L for large (100x50x100), or E for extra large (120x60x120).

Field.name: ExtraResidualTargets
Field.usage: Extra target residual values for Findwarp in final trial
Field.manpage: Extra target residual values for Findwarp in final trial. These values should be higher than any of the ones present on the \fB-warplimit\fR entry in matchorwarp.com. However, if they are already present at the end of the existing list, they will be removed for the earlier trials.

Field.name: HighDensityFinalTrial
Field.usage: 1 to do a final trial with much higher patch density , or -1 not to
Field.manpage: Enter -1 to prevent a higher density final trial even when "patchcorr.com" has initial shifts, or 1 to make it happen even without the initial shifts.

Field.name: TrialMode
Field.usage: Run Matchorwarp with -trial option to stop before Matchvol/Warpvol

Field.name: SkipFirstPatchcorr
Field.usage: Skip the first run of patchcorr and work from existing patches
Field.manpage: Skip the first run of patchcorr and work from existing patches. There is no check that the existing patch.out is based on the correct patch size; this option is purely for testing.
